_comment: Declarative agent registry for `python -m local_agent.suite`. Overlays local_agent/suite/agents.py:DEFAULT_AGENTS. Add a model = add an object here; no code change. Fields: name (required), provider, model, base_url, ollama_host, context_window, local, api_docs, upskill, fast, note. Prices are NOT here; see cost.py.

agents.name: claude
agents.note: Golden baseline. Bills ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. No injection.

agents.name: claude-kadas
agents.note: Sonnet as the KADAS dock runs it: full tools + operations guide. Context-reduction baseline.

agents.name: claude-kadas-fast
agents.note: claude-kadas in Fast mode (compact tools, 500-token guide, max_tokens clamped to 2048).

agents.name: local-raw
agents.note: LM Studio, nothing injected. Baseline the local variants must beat.

agents.name: local-plan
agents.note: + plan-first reasoning. Isolates the planning pass.

agents.name: local-plan-both
agents.note: + docs + upskilling + plan-first. The full small-model stack.
